# Rupan — Bangladeshi Premium E-Commerce Storefront

> Rupan (myrupan.com) is a leading omnichannel Bangladeshi e-commerce brand specializing in luxury traditional Panjabi, contemporary ethnic wear, western essentials, electronic gadgets, household utilities, and lifestyle collections.

## Store Overview
- **Brand Name:** Rupan (রূপান)
- **Primary Domain:** https://www.myrupan.com
- **Operating Region:** Bangladesh (All 64 districts covered)
- **Currency:** Bangladeshi Taka (BDT, ৳)
- **Customer Helpline:** +8801600338318
- **WhatsApp Support:** +8801974793083
- **Order Processing:** Cash on Delivery (COD) supported nationwide with digital verification options (bKash, Nagad, Cards).

## Product Categories & Offerings
1. **Panjabi & Traditional Wear:** Royal Jacquard panjabis, semi-fitted cotton panjabis, kabli sets, and festive collections.
2. **Coordinated Sets & Couple Collections:** Matching crimson, pastel, and festive couple dresses.
3. **Western Essentials:** Premium 180 GSM combed cotton t-shirts, henleys, drop-shoulder apparel, and casual shirts.
4. **Sarees & Women's Fashion:** Cotton embroidered sarees, floral applique work, party wear, and accessories.
5. **Electronics & Gadgets:** Smartwatches, TWS earbuds, portable lifestyle utilities, and kitchen electronics.
6. **Household & Kids:** Bedding essentials, educational toys, and daily home items.

## Delivery & Logistics Policy
- **Inside Dhaka City:** ৳60 (Standard 24-48 hours delivery)
- **Outside Dhaka Suburbs & Districts:** ৳120 (Standard 48-72 hours delivery via Steadfast, Pathao, RedX)
- **Free Shipping Threshold:** Orders of ৳6,500 and above qualify for free standard shipping.
- **Return & Exchange:** 7 days exchange policy for size or manufacturer defects.

## Canonical Product URL Format
- Individual products can be discovered and referenced directly via:
  `https://www.myrupan.com/product/{slug}`
  Example: `https://www.myrupan.com/product/a9-pro-app-supported-anc-enc-display-touch-control-earbuds-5184`

## Structured Sitemaps & Feeds
- XML Sitemap: https://www.myrupan.com/sitemap.xml
- Store Catalog Index: https://www.myrupan.com/shop
